facts.text: The resort sits on a bay looking out to the East Vietnam Sea and is reached by water.
facts.excerpt: bay looking out to the East Vietnam Sea so it can only be approached by water

facts.text: The setting has rock formations, a white sand beach and a backdrop of towering mountains.
facts.excerpt: Impressive rock formations, a white sand beach, and a backdrop of towering mountains add to the fantasy.

facts.text: A troop of rare endangered monkeys lives in the hills behind the resort.
facts.excerpt: We have a troop of rare endangered monkeys that call the hills behind our Vietnam beach resort their home.

facts.text: Villas are directly on the beach, over the water, between the rocks or on a mountain slope.
facts.excerpt: directly on the beach, over the water, between the rocks or on a mountain slope

facts.text: All villas offer panoramic ocean views.
facts.excerpt: all of which offer panoramic ocean views

facts.text: Villas have a garden terrace or sundeck.
facts.excerpt: Luxuriate in your spacious villa with garden terrace or sundeck

facts.text: The resort is near Nha Trang.
facts.excerpt: our proximity to Nha Trang and calm sheltered bay offers a host of land and water activities

facts.text: The calm sheltered bay offers land and water activities.

facts.text: A spa experience offers a traditional bamboo massage followed by a Reiki Crystal Facial.
facts.excerpt: Traditional bamboo massage followed by Reiki Crystal Facial and refreshments
